top5.text: Nawrocki vetoed the PIT/CIT reform on deadline day, so 2027 taxes stay as they are unless the Sejm finds a 3/5 majority. He also vetoed a higher sugar fee.
Decisions on the abortion bills and the judges' status act are still pending; MPs say the abortion deadline is Monday.
India's Cabinet reportedly cleared a revised delimitation bill: 50% more Lok Sabha seats for every state, shares frozen until 2051. It goes to the Nov 30 sitting.
Poland signed a five-year deal for Palantir's Maven AI battlefield system despite calls for a security audit.
Kraków opens its SCT shrink consultation (to 18 Dec) and the Christmas market under tight security; hard frost tonight.

US.text: Reuters: hackers breached the Air Force's Cloud One platform, which hosts payroll, munitions tracking and air-defence radar software; Cyber Command is assessing the damage.
Trump publicly backed Iraqi PM al-Zaidi's push to take control of Kurdish oilfields and borders and disarm militias, which fits the US pressure campaign on Iran.
Trump defended his friendship with Putin, said Putin is welcome at the Dec 14–15 Miami G20, and played down Russian and Chinese help to Iran; Zelensky called the friendship 'strange'.
Measles keeps spreading: Minnesota has its most cases since 1990, Wisconsin passed 918 cases with three deaths this month, and Ohio reached 400.
Stocks surged in Friday's shortened session (S&P 500 +1.6%, Nasdaq +2.3%), capping their best week in months; Anthropic climbed back above its IPO price.
Power and air travel were recovering after the Thanksgiving storm, but hundreds of thousands were still without power on Friday and the busiest return-travel days are still ahead.

Poland.text: Nawrocki vetoed the PIT/CIT reform (130,000 zł threshold, 22% CIT for big firms, lower ryczałt limit), so current tax rules stay for 2027 unless the Sejm overrides with 3/5.
Tusk extended the BRAVO/BRAVO-CRP alert nationwide and CHARLIE on the railways to Feb 28, 2027.
Nawrocki vetoed a sugar-fee increase for the second time; the Health Ministry says the NFZ loses about 1.3bn zł a year.
Nawrocki signed laws raising family-foundation tax to 19%, changing tax reliefs, and creating 4.8bn zł of aid for energy-intensive industry.
Prosecutors released international expert findings that the 2010 Smolensk crash was an accident with no evidence of an explosion; PiS called it manipulation.
The Tribunal's disciplinary court, made up of government-backed judges, suspended Święczkowski as president for 12 months; he calls the ruling void.
Warsaw is appealing the ruling that let the Tribunal protest camp stay; Kaczyński called a rally there for Sunday Nov 29 at 15:00.
Żabka franchisees allege a misleading model with VAT debts of up to 1.2m zł; a crime notice and labour-inspection referral have been filed, and Żabka rejects the claims.

Kraków.text: Consultation on shrinking the SCT to about 1 km² of the centre runs from 27 Nov to 18 Dec, with four public meetings; the fee-freeze consultation closed on 27 Nov.
The 2 Dec council agenda has first readings of the 2027 budget and financial forecast and the second reading of the 20/40-minute ticket fare resolution.
Kraków.thread: Kraków city finances and the 2027 budget

Kraków.text: PESA has started building Kraków's 65 new trams; MPK expects the first in mid-2027 and says the first 30 will let it retire all high-floor trams.
The Main Square Christmas market opened with barriers, extra guards, cameras and patrols after the 7 Nov attack; a residents' group objects to trading until 23:00 at weekends.
The parents of the girl shot at on ul. Grodzka during the 7 Nov attack have come forward to prosecutors, who treat it as attempted murder and have granted the family victim status.
Kraków will give the city police 200,000 zł for bulletproof vests and rescue kits, Mayor Gibała announced, after reports that officers in the 7 Nov attack wore private vests.
Kraków.thread: Gibała's first months as Kraków mayor

Kraków.text: Kraków is appealing the voivode's permit for UKEN's shooting range in Bronowice, citing over 270 trees to be felled and the decision's immediate enforceability.

India.text: The Cabinet reportedly cleared a revised delimitation and women's quota amendment: a uniform 50% rise in Lok Sabha seats, with state shares frozen until 2051, before the Nov 30 special sitting.
The NCP(SP) says it will back the delimitation bill and Congress calls that 'unfortunate'. Kharge has called opposition floor leaders, including the DMK, AAP and BJD, to plan for the special sitting.

The Supreme Court suspended the Thiruparankundram temple trustees, appointed two ex-judges as receivers, ordered the lamp lit on Nov 28 under CRPF guard, and issued contempt notices to top Tamil Nadu officials.
The Bombay HC denied the Tata Trusts interim relief against Chandrasekaran's third term and let the Nov 30 Tata Sons board meeting proceed, subject to final orders. The next hearing is Jan 18.
The Sensex fell 989 points and the Nifty closed at 25,607 as Brent neared $98. Forex reserves dropped $4.44bn to a 16-week low of $700.9bn.
Leh authorities are seeking a peace bond from Sonam Wangchuk before the Dec 4 hill council polls. He refuses to sign and must reply by Nov 28.
India.thread: Ladakh statehood protests and council polls

India.text: Cold wave and dense fog hit north India. Delhi's AQI briefly hit 393 overnight before settling at a 'poor' 220, and November has had no 'severe' days so far.
FSSAI sanctioned prosecution of Bisleri after coliform bacteria were found in a West Bengal packaged water sample. A nationwide packaged-water testing drive is under way.

city.text: Andrzejki night service: on Fri/Sat night (27–28 Nov) and Sun/Mon night (29–30 Nov), extra night buses 604 and 618 run hourly (about 23:30–2:00), 605 and 664 every 15 min, and 611 more often; trams 62 and 69 use larger vehicles. No reinforcement was announced for Sat/Sun night.
The Ruszcza tunnel (ul. Za Górą works) is closed until Sat 28 Nov 23:00, and bus 160 is detoured. Check the ZTP notice for the route.
Air is good after the snowfall: Kraków's overall AQI was 36 at 05:00 Saturday (PM2.5 AQI 36, PM10 AQI 10, unverified GIOŚ/WIOŚ data). No smog alert was found.

The IMGW heavy-snow warning for Kraków expired on Fri 27 Nov at 18:00, after 10–15 cm of snow. No frost warning was found, but IMGW expects Saturday night to be one of the coldest of the autumn, about -8°C in Kraków and down to about -12°C on Sunday morning, so expect icy pavements.

Christmas market official opening Sat 28 Nov at 12:00 on Rynek Główny with Trebunie-Tutki. Open daily to 22:00 (Fri/Sat to 23:00), with barriers and extra patrols in place. Karta Krakowska holders get 20% off food.
Weekend: the Christmas Fair of Unique Things on Rynek Podgórski (Sat–Sun 11:00–20:00, free, about 90 stalls); a model railway show at NCK; Wisła v Motor Lublin at 20:15 on Saturday.

US–Poland.text: Poland signed a five-year deal, worth about 1bn zł, for Palantir's Maven AI battlefield system ('Saturn'); Gawkowski and Panoptykon had asked for a security audit first.

US–India.text: India is reportedly drafting a formal rebuttal to USTR's proposed Section 301 tariffs and wants any deal to keep it ahead of Asian rivals (single source, unnamed officials).

rules.name: Bill amending PIT and CIT (2027 tax reform, resubmitted)
rules.changes: Vetoed on Nov 27. Would have added a 24% PIT band (130–150k zł), 22% CIT for firms with revenue above €50m, a 5% solidarity levy and a lower ryczałt limit. Current rules stay for 2027 unless the Sejm overrides (3/5 needed).
rules.affects: Higher earners, the largest companies and the self-employed on the lump-sum tax.

rules.name: Amendment on taxation of family foundations (print 3148)
rules.changes: Raises tax on benefits paid out by family foundations and on hidden profits from 15% to 19%. Limits the CIT rental exemption to long-term housing. Assets put in from 2027 must be held two years to keep sale proceeds tax-exempt. Unrepaid loans to founders count as hidden profit. Until end-2027, property can be returned to founders tax-free.
rules.affects: Owners and beneficiaries of family foundations (wealthy families, family businesses)

rules.name: Act on support for energy-intensive sectors (print 3159)
rules.changes: Creates a 4.8bn zł aid programme for companies hit by high electricity prices.

rules.name: Amendment to the Citizenship Rules, 2009 (digital citizenship certificates)
rules.changes: People granted Indian citizenship by registration or naturalisation now get a digitally signed certificate by default. A paper copy is issued only if they ask for one.
rules.affects: New citizens by registration or naturalisation, including CAA applicants, and the zonal registration authorities

rules.name: Draft resolution freezing Clean Transport Zone (SCT) entry fees for 2027-2028
rules.changes: Keeps SCT entry fees at 100 zł a month, 2.50 zł an hour or 5 zł a day through 2027-2028, instead of the scheduled rise to 250 zł a month in 2027 and 500 zł in 2028. Zone area, emission rules and exemptions stay the same.
rules.affects: Drivers of non-compliant cars entering the SCT, and Kraków residents who pay for entry

deepDive.title: Kraków's clean-air zone, take two: a smaller SCT and cheaper entry
deepDive.body:
Kraków is rewriting its Clean Transport Zone (SCT) in two steps, and both moved this week. On 27 Nov the city closed consultation on a draft that would **freeze entry fees** for non-compliant cars at 100 zł a month (or 5 zł a day) through 2028, instead of letting them rise to 250 zł in 2027 and 500 zł in 2028. The same day it opened consultation on a second draft that would **shrink the zone** from almost the whole city to roughly 1 km² of the centre. That runs to 18 Dec, with four public meetings starting 3 Dec in Nowa Huta ([krakow.pl](https://krakow.pl/strefa_czystego_transportu_w_krakowie/346864,2353,komunikat,jakie_granice_i_zasady_strefy_czystego_transportu__ruszaja_konsultacje.html)).

The fee freeze is not on the 2 Dec council agenda, so a vote will come later. Together the two drafts would turn the SCT from a citywide rule into a small central zone with lower charges; how much that changes exhaust levels outside the centre is the question the consultation is meant to test. A separate draft for a local referendum (SCT, short-term rentals, carriages) is still pending.

Transit is the other half of the bargain. PESA has started building Kraków's 65 new low-floor trams; MPK expects the first in mid-2027 and says the first 30 will retire every high-floor tram ([LoveKraków](https://lovekrakow.pl/nowe-tramwaje-przyjada-juz-w-2027-roku-mpk-zapowiada-koniec-wysokiej)). The ring road completed on 26 Nov should pull some through-traffic out of the city, while the metro stays on hold without state money.

For context, winter is when air matters most. Saturday morning's readings were good after fresh snow, but calm frosty nights are when PM10 builds. Delhi, at the other end of this brief, logged a 'poor' AQI of 220 on Friday after an overnight spike, with no 'severe' days so far this November.

**What to watch:** consultation turnout, whether the council votes the fee freeze before 1 Jan, and the 2 Dec budget reading.
